integrity: The proof is analytic: local Clifford geometry gives the product threshold; odd tensor parity gives B^2=mI; binary spectral data processing gives the information bound. The bundled checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Odd n>=3, pairwise anticommuting Hermitian unitaries, finite dimensions, and natural-log total correlation. The theorem gives a lower bound, not the exact fixed-expectation optimum, and does not cover even n.
title: A binary-relative-entropy upgrade for odd Clifford multipartite witnesses
